from_quote: Will the Clerk read the clause of the Constitution?
rationale: The speaker asks the Clerk to read "the clause of the Constitution" on amendment, which the Clerk then reads; it is Article V.

from_quote: with the exceptions contained in that proviso
rationale: The paragraph names the exceptions "contained in that proviso" of the clause just read, which is Article V.

from_quote: the very first amendment that was made under this power refers to the subject of religion and the freedom of speech
rationale: The paragraph names "the very first amendment", on religion and the freedom of speech.

from_quote: our national Constitution requires a republican form of government
rationale: The paragraph says "our national Constitution requires a republican form of government"; only the guarantee clause of Article IV, Section 4 fits.
